probes.name: fresh-expression-new-anchor
probes.source:
Function Describe(f As Object) As String
Describe="range=" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ";formula=" & CStr(f.Formula1) & ";priority=" & CStr(f.Priority)
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Snapshot=Describe(Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions(1))
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object,s As String
ActiveSheet.Name="Data"
Set f=Range("A1:A5").FormatConditions.Add(2,Formula1:="=A1>0")
s="before=[" & Describe(f) & "]"
f.ModifyAppliesToRange Union(Range("M8:M9"),Range("K3:K5"))
Probe=s & ";held=[" & Describe(f) & "];fresh=[" & Snapshot() & "]"
End Function
